user.title: Kiosk Music Assistant Cards
user.description: Load the Kiosk Music Assistant cards in the Home Assistant frontend.

abort.already_configured: Kiosk Music Assistant Cards is already configured.

get_track_lyrics.name: Get track lyrics
get_track_lyrics.description: Return the plain and synchronised (LRC) lyrics Music Assistant has for a track.

config_entry_id.name: Music Assistant
config_entry_id.description: The Music Assistant config entry to query.

uri.name: Track URI
uri.description: Music Assistant URI of the track.

get_top_picks.name: Get top picks
get_top_picks.description: Return Music Assistant's recommendations, completed with recently played items.

config_entry_id.name: Music Assistant
config_entry_id.description: The Music Assistant config entry to query.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

get_recommendations.name: Get recommendations
get_recommendations.description: Return Music Assistant's recommendation rows (discover feed), each with its items.

config_entry_id.name: Music Assistant
config_entry_id.description: The Music Assistant config entry to query.

username.name: Music Assistant user
username.description: Optional Music Assistant username to fetch the recommendations for.

row_limit.name: Items per row
row_limit.description: Maximum number of items per recommendation row.

include_hidden.name: Include hidden rows
include_hidden.description: Also return the rows Music Assistant hides by default.

source.name: Source
source.description: music_assistant: Music Assistant rows. similar: new tracks recommended by your music providers (Spotify, Tidal, YouTube Music, Deezer...) from your listening history. mixed: similar tracks first, then Music Assistant rows (falls back to Music Assistant rows when no provider can recommend).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Rebuild the recommendations now instead of returning the cached ones (cached 30 minutes, rebuilt in the background).

spotify_entity.name: SpotifyPlus player
spotify_entity.description: SpotifyPlus media player of the account whose Spotify listening history (top and recently played tracks) seeds the recommendations. Optional: without it, the Music Assistant listening history and favourites are used.

get_queue_items.name: Get queue items
get_queue_items.description: Return one page of a Music Assistant player queue, with its size and the current position.

config_entry_id.name: Music Assistant
config_entry_id.description: The Music Assistant config entry to query.

queue_id.name: Queue
queue_id.description: Queue id (the active_queue attribute of the player).

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: First item to return. Default: the current track.

play_tracks.name: Play tracks
play_tracks.description: Play the first track at once (new queue), then append the others in the background.

uris.name: Tracks
uris.description: Music Assistant URIs; the first one plays immediately.

username.name: Music Assistant user
username.description: Optional Music Assistant user to play as.

play_now.name: Play track now
play_now.description: Play a track at once in place of the current one; the rest of the queue is kept.

uri.name: Track
uri.description: Music Assistant URI of the track.

username.name: Music Assistant user
username.description: Optional Music Assistant user to play as.

autofill_similar.name: Add similar tracks
autofill_similar.description: Once the track plays, queue similar tracks if it is alone in the queue.

remove_queue_item.name: Remove from queue
remove_queue_item.description: Remove one track from the active queue of a Music Assistant player.

autofill_queue.name: Autofill queue
autofill_queue.description: Queue 10 tracks similar to the current one when it is the last track of the queue.

username.name: Music Assistant user
username.description: Optional Music Assistant user to act as.
